demo.program:
# CSS — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created CSS?", "Håkon Wium Lie"),
    ("What paradigm is CSS?", "stylesheet"),
    ("What is creator?", "Håkon Wium Lie"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1996"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "stylesheet"),
    ("What is typing?", "none"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".css"),
    ("What is hello world?", "/* styles Hello, world! */"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
